title: Session
description: A session. Returned straight from MongoDB: `_id` is renamed to `id`; fields not yet known for an open session may be absent.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Normally UTC with offset (Z or +00:00). Rows stored before scripts/migrate_timestamps.py was run may lack an offset; treat those as UTC.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Normally UTC with offset (Z or +00:00). Rows stored before scripts/migrate_timestamps.py was run may lack an offset; treat those as UTC.

items.description: ATT&CK technique id, e.g. T1082 or T1110.001. Heuristic tag, not a confirmed technique.

techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ids matched by the rule set in app/mitre.py (heuristic). Absent on rows stored before the MITRE backfill ran.
